lines.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite.
O LORD, the God of my salvation,
day and night I cry out before You.
May my prayer come before You;
incline Your ear to my cry.
For my soul is full of troubles,
and my life draws near to Sheol.
I am counted among those descending to the Pit.
I am like a man without strength.
I am forsaken among the dead,
like the slain who lie in the grave,
who are cut off from Your care.

pictures.scene: Johannes Bosboom, Kerkinterieur — the tall empty church where the sons of Korah sang, a Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite, O LORD, the God of my salvation
pictures.name: pd_bosboom_kerk

pictures.scene: Petrus van Schendel, Fish seller — the woman working on by candlelight after dark, day and night I cry out before You, may my prayer come before You
pictures.name: pd_schendel_nacht

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, Schwerer Gang — the two bowed figures dragging through the cold mud of the lane, incline Your ear to my cry, for my soul is full of troubles
pictures.name: pd_uhde_schwerer_gang

pictures.scene: Anton Mauve, Huiswaarts — the flock trudging home into the failing light, and my life draws near to Sheol, I am counted among those descending to the Pit
pictures.name: pd_mauve_huiswaarts

pictures.scene: Jozef Israëls, Alleen — the old man sitting alone with nothing left in his hands, I am like a man without strength, I am forsaken among the dead
pictures.name: pd_israels_alleen

pictures.scene: Michael Ancher, The Drowned Fisherman — the body carried up from the sea on a plank, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more
pictures.name: pd_ancher_druknede

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, La Grotte de la Loue — the black mouth of the cave in the rock, who are cut off from Your care, You have laid me in the lowest Pit
pictures.name: pd_courbet_grotte
